edges: Fidel Castro sent a letter to Kofi Annan assuring him that Cuba will continue to treat anti-terrorism measures.
Fidel Castro visits the United Nations.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: UN peacekeepers were responsible for disarming the defenders of the Muslims of Srebrenica.
Kofi Annan noted that the Iraqi people turned out in large numbers to vote.

multi_hop_neighbors.neighbor: Judges of the International Tribunal for War Crimes
multi_hop_neighbors.edge: The United Nations elected eight judges to the International Tribunal for War Crimes.
Kofi Annan and Nane Annan are greeted by President Fidel Castro upon their arrival.
